page: Microsoft Azure M128bds_3_v3 is a memory-optimized server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, delivering 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system operates at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz and features a dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 2794.0 GB of RAM, translating to 21.83 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled with 6144 GB of capacity, and the server is premium storage capable. No GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier capabilities in memory bandwidth, with read-only small block cached bandwidth reaching 9024.88 GB/sec and large block uncached write bandwidth at 187.69 GB/sec. The processor demonstrates strong multi-core performance, scoring 110316.39 in stress-ng multi-core tests and 106798.23 in PassMark CPU tests. Single-core performance is average to top-tier depending on the workload, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2181.0. Database operations are highly efficient, as shown by a PassMark database score of 34530.34 and Redis SET operations reaching 139.35 million operations per second.

The server offers high resource density, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound enterprise workloads that require massive RAM arrays and local storage without the overhead of external disk latency. However, a potential tradeoff is the average single-core stress-ng performance and average PassMark memory score relative to its top-tier raw bandwidth. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, software compilation, and medium-to-large LLM inference tasks where high memory capacity and fast read-write speeds are critical.
